<enum>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<description>Enumerations used in <page>ENTITY:UpdateTransmitState</page> hook.</description>
	<items>
<item key="TRANSMIT_ALWAYS" value="0">Always transmit the entity</item>

<item key="TRANSMIT_NEVER" value="1">Never transmit the entity, default for point entities</item>

<item key="TRANSMIT_PVS" value="2">Transmit when entity is in players [PVS (Potential Visibility Set)](https://developer.valvesoftware.com/wiki/PVS "PVS - Valve Developer Community")</item>
	</items>

</enum>
